subject: SignedCapsulePkg: Remove package
reasons: This is a wholesale package deletion — 34 files removed, ~6784 lines deleted
Coccinelle operates on C source transformations; removing an entire package (including .inf, .dec, .dsc, .uni, .md files) is not a C-code structural transformation
There is no before/after pattern to express as an SmPL rule — the change is simply deleting all files in a directory tree
